TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A digitally rendered, translucent x-ray style human figure stands front-facing against a dark cosmic background, arms slightly spread, with the skeleton, blue veins and red arteries visible through the wireframe skin. A beam of golden light descends from the upper right and strikes the figure's left shoulder area, scattering glowing golden particles and spawning crack-like cyan energy patterns across the chest; the abdominal organs (liver, intestines) glow amber-gold. Behind the figure is a large sacred-geometry pattern of overlapping circles and connecting lines in purple and blue, and small glitchy black-and-red rectangles float across the torso, arms and legs like digital artifacts. The skull is visible inside the glowing head.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: skull

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A massive rusted steel vault door stands ajar at the end of a dark concrete bunker corridor, brilliant golden light spilling from the opening. A faded red rubber stamp reading CLASSIFIED marks the door, which is fitted with heavy hinges, locking pins and a spoked wheel handle. Glowing, translucent blueprint-style technical documents showing schematic drawings of machines and equipment drift out of the vault trailing wisps of golden smoke, while stacks of papers sit on shelves inside the lit interior; a single rectangular ceiling light glows at the top of the frame.
TEXT: CLASSIFIED
SYMBOLS: door

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A dark silhouetted human figure stands in the corner of a bare concrete room, backlit and crackling with blue-white electric arcs that burst from a bright node at the center of the chest and branch down the arms, legs and torso like lightning. Glowing teal, code-like text is projected faintly across the concrete walls and ceiling, too small and blurred to read, resembling terminal logs or data streams. On the floor, luminous blue lines fan outward from beneath the figure's feet, spreading into a web of intersecting network strands across the concrete.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A cinematic digital graphic showing planet Earth from space at night, overlaid with a glowing blue network grid of interconnected nodes spanning the continents against a starfield. Centered on the globe is a large polished golden shield emblem with the word ODIN across its face, encircled by sweeping golden orbital rings and particle trails. Below the shield, bold golden 3D lettering reads THE PROTOCOL: ACTIVE, and in the lower right corner a silver bird logo in flight sits above the word ODIN.
TEXT: ODIN, THE PROTOCOL: ACTIVE, ODIN
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A large wall-mounted flat screen in a dark, smoke-hazed server room displays a satellite-style world map with dense clusters of bright blue glowing points over North America and Europe, surrounded by thin black cables and drifts of fog. Red alert text is overlaid on the screen in three places — across the top, near the lower left, and twice along the right side — reading SYSTEM FAILURE // DATA CORRUPTION DETECTED // CRITICAL ERROR and ERR 505, with the map itself rendered in dark teal and brown tones. A torn monitor or server unit hangs below the right edge of the screen.
TEXT: SYSTEM FAILURE // DATA CORRUPTION DETECTED // CRITICAL ERROR, ERR 505, ERR 505, SYSTEM FAILURE // DATA CORRUPTION DETECTED // CRITICAL ERROR, ERR 505
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A sci-fi medical laboratory render: inside a tall glass cylinder chamber two kidneys float side by side — the left one dark, cracked and stone-like with glowing orange patches and teal branching vessels dissolving into drifting particles, the right one a smooth, healthy pink kidney with its ureter. Golden light beams radiate up from a circular platform beneath them, and the chamber sits in a corridor lined with teal and amber neon strips, control consoles and panels. Three holographic data readouts with small line and bar charts label the scene, tracking fluidion rate, stone dissolution progress and nephron count.
TEXT: FLUIDION RATE: 622 (INCREASING), STONE DISSOLUTION PROGRESS: 35%, NEPHRON COUNT: 1.5 MILLION (RISING)
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: An extreme close-up 3D render of two biological tissue cross-sections facing each other against a blurred dark blue cellular background: the left one is blackened and charred with a butterfly-shaped inner structure like a burnt spinal cord slice, while the right one is a fresh pink organ cross-section with fine surface vessels. Thin golden filament wires stretch between the two surfaces with tiny electric sparks flaring at their attachment points, and a dense stream of glowing teal, sperm-like cells with whip-like tails flows from the dark tissue toward the healthy pink one, bridging the gap.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art

The organ's upper surface is encased in a translucent honeycomb lattice dome filled with clusters of glowing green spherical cells. In the background, white wall panels carry cool blue neon light strips, a glass display console shows faint holographic imagery, and additional robotic arm segments and monitors appear on the right.
TEXT: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A dark, futuristic medical laboratory render where three large curved wall screens display the Japanese flag — a red disc on white — with the central screen flanked by two angled copies on either side. Above a black console table in the room's center float holographic projections: a blue-and-red DNA double helix, a translucent human heart glowing red at its core, molecular diagrams, and grid panels of charts and data graphs. The room is lined with glass-walled bays, red-and-white LED strip lighting, lab machines, monitors and cabinets, with a gridded dark ceiling overhead.

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A scientific 3D illustration of a large, dark reddish-brown tumor mass with a rough, fibrous cracked surface, its interior revealed through fissures where pale white spiky cells cluster. Concentric glowing cyan rings of energy descend from a cylindrical emitter probe at the top of the frame, and hundreds of translucent blue bubbles swarm around the tumor within a faint spherical boundary. Two annotation labels with leader lines identify the elements: Nanobubbles pointing to the bubble swarm on the left, and Solid tumor with fibrous, rough collagen walls pointing to the mass on the right.
